findings.evidenceJa: 燃え爛れる町の中で
findings.governingReading: Shirou pursued the responsibility of sole survival amid a town burning and blistering away.
findings.explanation: The English reduces the consuming townscape to “the fire.”

findings.evidenceJa: [line4]　　るのか？
findings.governingReading: A deliberately partial accusation ending in “...るのか?” surfaces in the dream.
findings.explanation: mirror moon leaves the staged fragment wholly blank.

findings.evidenceJa: 裏切るのか？
findings.governingReading: The recovered accusation asks, “Will you betray it?”
findings.explanation: mirror moon leaves the accusation wholly blank.

findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=オヤジ char=2]切嗣
findings.governingReading: The written name Kiritsugu is read with Shirou’s intimate “old man/Dad” address.
findings.explanation: The English preserves only the name and loses the relational reading.

findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮士郎の年月
findings.governingReading: The years of Emiya Shirou’s life existed solely for the vow.
findings.explanation: The English reduces the long accumulated span to days.

findings.highlight: I let others use me so that I could hold my head up high before those who were not saved
findings.evidenceJa: 救われなかった人たちに胸を張れるように使われ続け
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s years continued to be spent so he could stand proudly before those who were not saved.
findings.explanation: The English invents other people using Shirou and makes him permit it.

findings.evidenceJa: かつての自分を裏切るのか？
findings.governingReading: The inward voice asks, “Will you betray your former self?”
findings.explanation: mirror moon leaves the explicit identity conflict wholly blank.

findings.evidenceJa: 空に穿たれたあの影
findings.governingReading: The black sun is a shadow bored or punctured into the sky.
findings.explanation: The English removes the violent hole-in-the-sky image.

findings.highlight: You have approved of yourself because you save innocent people, because you save people who ask for help
findings.evidenceJa: 救いを求める人々を救う為に、無関係に巻き込まれていく誰かを助ける為に自らを肯定してきた
findings.governingReading: Shirou has affirmed his existence in order to save people seeking rescue and people dragged into harm despite being uninvolved.
findings.explanation: The English changes the purpose of self-affirmation into a record of successful rescue.

findings.evidenceJa: 無関係に巻き込まれていく誰か
findings.governingReading: The imagined beneficiaries include people drawn into events despite having no relation to them.
findings.explanation: The English replaces relational noninvolvement with moral innocence.

findings.evidenceJa: それを裏切るというのなら、おまえは
findings.governingReading: The accusation continues: “If you mean to betray that, then you...”
findings.explanation: mirror moon leaves the conditional lead-in wholly blank.

findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮士郎は、自分自身に裁かれる事になる
findings.governingReading: The dream concludes that Emiya Shirou will be judged by himself.
findings.explanation: mirror moon omits the identity and judgment that complete the accusation.

findings.highlight: My dull head can’t remember who I am
findings.evidenceJa: まだ血が巡っていないのか
findings.governingReading: Shirou wonders whether blood has not yet begun circulating properly.
findings.explanation: The English omits his tentative bodily explanation for the dulled mind.

findings.evidenceJa: ぽんぽん、と桜の肩に触れる
findings.governingReading: Shirou touches Sakura’s shoulder repeatedly with light pats.
findings.explanation: The English reduces the repeated contact to one tap.

findings.highlight: her sensation is cold, and she’s also hard
findings.evidenceJa: 感触が冷たいし、硬かった
findings.governingReading: What Shirou touches feels cold and hard.
findings.explanation: The English assigns a “sensation” to Sakura and describes her as “hard,” obscuring the tactile evidence.

findings.evidenceJa: ぼんやりした頭のまま、体を起こして
findings.governingReading: Still mentally dazed, Shirou sits himself up.
findings.explanation: The English omits the dazed state and calques the physical action unnaturally.

findings.highlight: I held on to her hand
findings.evidenceJa: 何処にも行かないように固く握った手の感触
findings.governingReading: Shirou remembers tightly gripping Sakura’s hand so she could not go anywhere.
findings.explanation: The English removes both the tightness and his protective motive.

findings.highlight: I hit my foot on the table
findings.evidenceJa: 避けようとしてテーブルに足をぶつける
findings.governingReading: Shirou strikes the table with his foot while attempting to avoid it.
findings.explanation: The English removes the failed evasive movement.

findings.highlight: whenever I do, it’s like my thoughts are ten seconds in the future
findings.evidenceJa: 深く考えようとすると十秒後の世界にいる
findings.governingReading: Whenever Shirou attempts deep thought, he finds himself in the world ten seconds later.
findings.explanation: The English turns an experienced gap in time into thoughts projecting ten seconds ahead.

findings.highlight: Blood won’t flow to my head
findings.evidenceJa: 起きたばかりの頭は血の巡りが悪く
findings.governingReading: His just-awakened head has poor blood circulation.
findings.explanation: The English omits the waking condition and changes impaired circulation into categorical absence of flow.

findings.highlight: head back to the living room
findings.evidenceJa: 居間へと踵を返す
findings.governingReading: Shirou turns on his heel toward the living room.
findings.explanation: The English preserves destination but removes the abrupt reversal.

findings.evidenceJa: そんな悠長な真似するか
findings.governingReading: Rin indignantly rejects the idea that she would engage in something so leisurely.
findings.explanation: The English changes rejection of an action into a stable personality description.
